scenario: LCON.2.6.1 within-platform integer determinism — floor division. `-7 // 2` is -4 (rounds toward negative infinity per LEXP.7.5), not -3 (C truncation). The inline guard `(t.x // 2) == -4` fires only if floor-division is correct, gating the emit; fact_count 2 (Trig + Hit) confirms the bit-exact value.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x // 2) == -4
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
